meta.title: Pricing · YukSaroy
meta.description: The catalogue, map and requests are free. One subscription: phone numbers, wagon search and listings ranked higher. Booking commission is 0 % for now.

pricing.title: Browsing is free. Working needs a subscription.
pricing.lead: The catalogue, map and requests are open to everyone and prices are not hidden from guests. A subscription opens phone numbers, lifts the wagon search limit and lifts your listings higher.

free.name: Free
free.f3: Inquiries and bookings in the dashboard
free.f4: Company page and the verified badge

subscription.f1: Phone numbers of listing and terminal owners, up to {phones} a day

subscription.hint: The catalogue, map, chat and requests stay open without one. A subscription does not renew itself: you extend it when it runs out.

commission.heading: Booking commission
commission.line: Booking commission is 0 % today. Once bookings exceed 100 per month it becomes 2 to 3 %, announced in advance.
commission.note: The tariff is frozen when an order is sent: a commission change never touches orders already sent.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I pay for the subscription?
faq.a1: On the subscription page you choose the term, then the amount and bank details appear. Payment is manual for now: after the transfer the platform confirms it and the subscription switches on. Payme and Click come later.
faq.q2: What does the subscription give me?
faq.a2: Only the position and the badge: the listing comes first in its category within the chosen sort, stands out on the map, and analytics open up. The number of views or inquiries is not guaranteed.
faq.q3: What if I have several listings?
faq.a3: A subscription belongs to a person and covers all of their listings; it does not grow with the number of them. With a very large number of listings the Deal plan is easier: get in touch.
faq.a4: When more than 100 orders a month go through the platform. Once the threshold is reached we announce it at least 30 days ahead; the rate will be 2 to 3 %.
faq.q5: Do terminal and siding owners pay?
faq.a5: No. The terminal page, tariffs, spots and accepting bookings are free. Claiming a private siding from the registry is free as well.
faq.a6: No. Tariffs and listing prices are open without login. An account is needed only to see the phone number and send an inquiry.
